title: Zesty Crispy Middle Eastern Walnut Cookies
description: Nutty, crispy cookies bursting with Middle Eastern flavors, perfect for a quick snack that is anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk whole wheat flour, almond flour, cumin, coriander and salt in a bowl until combined.
In a separate bowl, beat butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg to the butter mixture and mix until smooth.
Stir in molasses and then fold in the dry flour mixture until just combined.
Fold in toasted walnuts, ensuring even distribution.
Drop tablespoon-sized dough onto prepared baking sheet, spacing 3 inches apart.
Bake for 12 minutes or until edges are golden and cookies are firm.
Let cookies cool on sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely.
Serve warm or at room temperature as a crunchy snack.
